title: Table 11: Forecast Revision Regressions: Human vs AI
original_notes: The table reports OLS regressions of forecast revisions on lagged forecast errors (Error Correction) and distance from SPF consensus (Consensus Tracking). Revisionit is the change in forecaster i’s nowcast from t − 1 to t. SPF regressions use individual forecaster microdata from the Philadelphia Fed (1999–2023). Robust standard errors in parentheses. ∗∗∗p < 0.01.
replication_notes: Both panels use nowcasts, strictly consecutive quarterly observations, a prior-quarter historical realization available in the current survey, the previous quarter’s official human nowcast median, OLS with an intercept, and HC1 robust SEs. Named AI forecast duplicates are averaged within person-quarter; placeholder names are excluded.
status: Independently verified recalculation under an explicitly declared nowcast method; not a recovery of the original Human estimator.

methodology.sample: 1999Q1–2023Q4, with both forecast quarters inside the sample
methodology.realized_error: Official SPF VAR1 at survey t minus same person nowcast from t−1
methodology.consensus: Same person nowcast from t−1 minus official SPF VAR2 median at t−1
methodology.AI_identity_rule: Exclude No Name Provided; mean of duplicate named person-quarter forecasts
methodology.human_identity_rule: Native anonymous ID; unique ID-quarter observations
methodology.OLS: Intercept plus one regressor; HC1 standard errors and normal-reference p-values
methodology.significance: *** p<0.01, matching the original Table 11 convention
